tok 1.0 "Central venous puncture"

pool hospital "Hospital"
  lane doctor "Doctor"
    start begin "Procedure needed"
    task prepare "Prepare the implements"
    task wash "Wash the hands"
    task dress "Get in sterile clothes"
    task clean "Clean the puncture area"
    task drape "Drape the puncture zone"
    task configure "Configure the ultrasound"
    task gel "Put gel in the probe"
    task cover "Cover the probe"
    task sterile "Put the sterile gel"
    task posprobe "Position the probe"
    task pospatient "Position the patient"
    xor vein "Identification method?"
    task anat "Identify the vein by anatomic identification"
    task dop "Identify the vein by doppler identification"
    task comp "Identify the vein by compression identification"
    xor veinj
    task anesth "Anesthetize the patient"
    task puncture "Puncture the patient"
    task blood "Check the blood return"
    xor bloodok "Blood return correct?"
    task dropprobe "Drop the probe"
    task syringe "Remove the syringe"
    task install "Install the guidewire"
    task trocar "Remove the trocar"
    xor axis "Axis of the check?"
    task longax "Check the wire in the long axis"
    task shortax "Check the wire in the short axis"
    xor axisj
    task pos "Check the wire position"
    xor posok "Wire in good position?"
    task widen "Widen the pathway"
    task advance "Advance the catheter"
    task remwire "Remove the guidewire"
    task flow "Verify the flow and the reflow"
    task catpos "Check the catheter position"
    end done "Catheter placed"

flow begin -> prepare -> wash -> dress -> clean -> drape -> configure -> gel -> cover -> sterile -> posprobe -> pospatient -> vein
flow vein -> anat "anatomic"
flow vein -> dop "doppler"
flow vein -> comp "compression"
flow anat -> veinj
flow dop -> veinj
flow comp -> veinj
flow veinj -> anesth -> puncture -> blood -> bloodok
flow bloodok -> anesth "no"
flow bloodok -> dropprobe "yes"
flow dropprobe -> syringe -> install -> trocar -> axis
flow axis -> longax "long axis"
flow axis -> shortax "short axis"
flow longax -> axisj
flow shortax -> axisj
flow axisj -> pos -> posok
flow posok -> anesth "no"
flow posok -> widen "yes"
flow widen -> advance -> remwire -> flow -> catpos -> done
